current.synoptic_overview: Pan-India composite synoptic pattern: high stagnation over northern plains, moderate maritime dispersion along western & southern coastal belts.
current.air_mass_trajectory: Inter-state air mass exchanges predominantly flowing northwest-to-southeast across the Indo-Gangetic conveyor.

current.synoptic_overview: Persistent continental north-westerly flow with an intensely compressed planetary boundary layer (390 m) causing nocturnal thermal inversion traps and high stagnation.
current.air_mass_trajectory: Plumes traversing north-westerly agricultural & industrial corridors (Punjab / Haryana / Panipat) entering Rohini & Anand Vihar.

current.synoptic_overview: Diurnal land-sea breeze oscillation with high marine humidity (74%). Morning calm transitions into moderate westerly sea breeze dispersing coastal corridors.
current.air_mass_trajectory: Refinery and petrochemical emissions from Chembur & Taloja drifting north-eastward over Navi Mumbai & Thane basin.

current.synoptic_overview: North-easterly to westerly valley breeze across the Mula-Mutha basin. Moderate boundary layer height (680 m) with evening temperature inversions.
current.air_mass_trajectory: Automotive & industrial emissions from Bhosari-PCMC corridor transported toward central Pune during calm evening hours.

current.synoptic_overview: Elevated Deccan plateau breeze with a well-developed vertical mixing layer (940 m) providing favorable aerodynamic dispersion.
current.air_mass_trajectory: Easterly convective breezes channeling industrial emissions from Peenya and Hosur road into suburban fringes.

current.synoptic_overview: Calm riverine moisture boundary layer with dense morning haze. Particulates trapped under low winter inversion ceiling (510 m).
current.air_mass_trajectory: Coal transit & industrial foundry plumes from Howrah & Asansol drifting along Hooghly river valley.

current.synoptic_overview: Extensive Indo-Gangetic valley air stagnation. Calm surface winds (<6 km/h) and low boundary layer creating a basin-wide particulate containment zone.
current.air_mass_trajectory: Regional agricultural biomass and industrial stack effluents pooling across the low-elevation alluvial plain.

current.synoptic_overview: Moderate south-easterly Deccan breeze with dry continental conditions. Moderate vertical mixing depth (780 m).
current.air_mass_trajectory: Bulk drug and pharmaceutical emissions from Sanathnagar & Pashamylaram dispersing along the ring road corridor.

current.synoptic_overview: Dry westerly Gulf breezes with strong thermal buoyancy during peak hours. High particulate resuspension potential.
current.air_mass_trajectory: Chemical dye and textile emissions from Vatva GIDC and Narol industrial belt carried toward eastern residential sectors.

stations.name: Narol Textile Processing Zone (Ahmedabad - Gujarat Industrial)
